title.zh: 卷一百〇六 志第五十九 禮九
title.raw: 卷一百〇六 志第五十九 禮九 Volume 106 Treatises 59: Rites 9

sentences.zh: 宗廟之制

translations.literal: Regulations on the Ancestral Temples
translations.idiomatic: Regulations Governing the Imperial Ancestral Temples

sentences.zh: 建隆元年，有司請立宗廟，詔下其議。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jianlong, the responsible officials requested that an ancestral temple be established; an edict was issued to submit the matter for discussion.
translations.idiomatic: In 960, the relevant officials petitioned to establish the imperial ancestral temple, and the emperor ordered the proposal debated.

sentences.zh: 兵部尚書張昭等奏：「謹案堯、舜、禹皆立五廟，蓋二昭二穆與其 始祖也。

translations.literal: Minister of War Zhang Zhao and others memorialized: "We respectfully note that Yao, Shun, and Yu each established five temples, comprising two zhao, two mu, and their founding ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhao, Minister of War, and others submitted: "We find that Yao, Shun, and Yu each maintained five ancestral shrines—two zhao, two mu, and the founding ancestor.

sentences.zh: 有商建國，改立六廟，蓋昭穆之外，祀契與湯也。

translations.literal: When the Shang founded their state, they changed to six temples, enshrining Qi and Tang beyond the zhao and mu.
translations.idiomatic: When the Shang established their dynasty, they expanded to six shrines, adding Qi and Tang beyond the usual zhao-mu pairs.

sentences.zh: 周立七廟，蓋親廟之外，祀太祖與文王、武王也。

translations.literal: The Zhou established seven temples, enshrining the Grand Ancestor together with King Wen and King Wu beyond the direct-line shrines.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhou arranged seven shrines, honoring the Grand Ancestor together with Kings Wen and Wu in addition to the direct-line temples.

sentences.zh: 漢初立廟，悉不如禮。

translations.literal: When the Han first established temples, none accorded with ritual propriety.
translations.idiomatic: The Han founders' temples, from the outset, failed to conform to proper ritual.

sentences.zh: 魏、晉始復七廟之制，江左相承 不改。

translations.literal: Wei and Jin first restored the system of seven temples; the region south of the Yangtze inherited this without change.
translations.idiomatic: The Wei and Jin dynasties revived the seven-shrine system, and the southern courts preserved it unchanged.

sentences.zh: 然七廟之室，隋文但立高、曾、祖、禰四廟而已。

translations.literal: Yet for the chambers of the seven temples, Emperor Wen of Sui built only four temples—for great-great-grandfather, great-grandfather, grandfather, and father.
translations.idiomatic: In practice, however, Emperor Wen of Sui built only four ancestral chambers—for four generations of immediate forebears.

sentences.zh: 唐因立親廟，梁氏而下，不易其法。

translations.literal: Tang then established direct-line temples; from the Liang onward, this law was not altered.
translations.idiomatic: The Tang followed with direct-line ancestral shrines, and from the Liang through the Five Dynasties the practice held steady.

sentences.zh: 稽古之道，斯為折衷。

translations.literal: Examining antiquity, this is the balanced compromise.
translations.idiomatic: Measured against ancient precedent, this represents a sound compromise.

sentences.zh: 伏請追尊高、曾四代，崇建廟室。」

translations.literal: We humbly request posthumous elevation of four generations—great-great-grandfather and above—and the exalted construction of temple chambers."
translations.idiomatic: We respectfully urge posthumous enshrinement of four generations of ancestors and construction of the corresponding temple halls."

sentences.zh: 於是判太常 寺竇儼奏上皇高祖文安府君曰文獻皇帝，廟號僖祖；

translations.literal: Thereupon Dou Yan, acting head of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, memorialized that His Majesty's great-great-grandfather, Lord Wen'an of Wen Prefecture, should be titled Emperor Wenxian, temple name Xizu;
translations.idiomatic: Dou Yan, acting director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, then proposed posthumous titles: the emperor's great-great-grandfather, Lord Wen'an, as Emperor Wenxian (temple name Xizu);

sentences.zh: 皇曾祖中丞府君曰惠元皇帝，廟號順祖；

translations.literal: His Majesty's great-grandfather, Lord Zhongcheng, as Emperor Huiyuan, temple name Shunzu;
translations.idiomatic: the great-grandfather, Lord Zhongcheng, as Emperor Huiyuan (temple name Shunzu);

sentences.zh: 皇祖驍衛府君曰簡恭皇帝，廟號翼祖；

translations.literal: His Majesty's grandfather, Lord of the Valiant Cavalry Guard, as Emperor Jiangong, temple name Yizu;
translations.idiomatic: the grandfather, Lord of the Valiant Cavalry Guard, as Emperor Jiangong (temple name Yizu);

sentences.zh: 皇考武清府君曰昭武皇帝，廟號 宣祖；

translations.literal: His Majesty's father, Lord Wuqing, as Emperor Zhaowu, temple name Xuanzu;
translations.idiomatic: the father, Lord Wuqing, as Emperor Zhaowu (temple name Xuanzu);

sentences.zh: 皇高祖妣崔氏曰文懿皇后；

translations.literal: His Majesty's great-great-grandmother, Lady Cui, as Empress Wenyi;
translations.idiomatic: the great-great-grandmother, Lady Cui, as Empress Wenyi;

sentences.zh: 皇曾祖妣桑氏曰惠明皇后；

translations.literal: His Majesty's great-grandmother, Lady Sang, as Empress Huiming;
translations.idiomatic: the great-grandmother, Lady Sang, as Empress Huiming;

sentences.zh: 皇祖妣京兆郡太夫人劉氏曰簡穆皇后。

translations.literal: His Majesty's grandmother, Grand Lady Liu of Jingzhao Commandery, as Empress Jianmu.
translations.idiomatic: and the grandmother, Grand Lady Liu of Jingzhao, as Empress Jianmu.

sentences.zh: 太祖禦崇元殿，備禮冊四親廟，奉安神主，行上諡之禮。

translations.literal: Taizu presided in the Chongyuan Hall, prepared the full rites to enshrine the four direct-line ancestral temples, installed the spirit tablets, and performed the ceremony of bestowing posthumous titles.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu presided in the Chongyuan Hall, conducted the full enshrinement rites for the four ancestral shrines, installed the spirit tablets, and bestowed posthumous titles.

sentences.zh: 二年十 月，祔明憲皇后杜氏於宣祖室。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the second year, Empress Mingxian, née Du, was enshrined alongside the Xuanzu shrine.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the following year, Empress Mingxian (née Du) was associated with the shrine of Xuanzu.

sentences.zh: 太平興國二年，有司言：「唐制，長安太廟，凡九廟，同殿異室。

translations.literal: In the second year of Taiping Xingguo, the responsible officials stated: "Under Tang regulations, the Chang'an Imperial Ancestral Temple comprised nine shrines in all, one hall with separate chambers.
translations.idiomatic: In 977, officials reported: "Under Tang practice, the Chang'an ancestral temple held nine shrines in a single hall with separate chambers.

sentences.zh: 其制：二十一間皆四柱，東西夾室各一，前後麵各三 階，東西各二側階。

translations.literal: Its design: twenty-one bays, each with four pillars; one flanking chamber on east and west; three steps on the front and rear faces; two side steps on east and west.
translations.idiomatic: The layout comprised twenty-one four-pillared bays, with one flanking chamber on each side, three steps at front and rear, and two side staircases on east and west.

sentences.zh: 本朝太廟四室，室三間。

translations.literal: Our dynasty's Imperial Ancestral Temple has four chambers, each of three bays.
translations.idiomatic: The present ancestral temple has four chambers of three bays each.

sentences.zh: 今太祖升祔，共成五室，請依長安之制，東西留夾室外，餘十間分為五室，室二間。」

translations.literal: Now that Taizu is elevated and enshrined, there are five chambers in all. We request that, following the Chang'an model, the flanking chambers be left on east and west, and the remaining ten bays be divided into five chambers of two bays each."
translations.idiomatic: With Taizu's enshrinement there are now five chambers. We propose following the Chang'an model: retain the flanking chambers on east and west and divide the remaining ten bays into five two-bay chambers."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 四月己卯，奉神主祔廟， 以孝明皇后王氏配。

translations.literal: On jimao in the fourth month, the spirit tablets were installed in the temple; Empress Xiaoming, née Wang, was associated in the shrine.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day of the fourth month, the spirit tablets were installed in the temple, with Empress Xiaoming (née Wang) enshrined alongside.

sentences.zh: 至道三年十一月甲子，奉太宗神主祔廟，以懿德皇后符氏配。

translations.literal: On jiazi in the eleventh month of the third year of Zhidao, Taizong's spirit tablet was installed in the temple; Empress Yide, née Fu, was associated in the shrine.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day of the eleventh month of 997, Taizong's spirit tablet was installed in the temple, with Empress Yide (née Fu) enshrined alongside.

sentences.zh: 咸平元年，判太常禮院李宗訥等言：「僖祖稱曾高祖，太祖稱伯；

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianping, Li Zong'e and others of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices stated: "Xizu is addressed as great-great-grandfather and great-grandfather; Taizu is addressed as elder uncle;
translations.idiomatic: In 998, Li Zong'e and others of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices argued: "In ritual address, Xizu is called great-great-grandfather and great-grandfather, while Taizu is called elder uncle;

sentences.zh: 文 懿、惠明、簡穆、昭憲皇后並稱祖妣，孝明、孝惠、孝章皇后並稱伯妣。

translations.literal: Empresses Wenyi, Huiming, Jianmu, and Zhaoxian are all addressed as ancestral grandmothers; Empresses Xiaoming, Xiaohui, and Xiaozhang are all addressed as elder uncles' consorts.
translations.idiomatic: Empresses Wenyi, Huiming, Jianmu, and Zhaoxian are all styled ancestral grandmothers, while Empresses Xiaoming, Xiaohui, and Xiaozhang are styled elder uncles' consorts.

sentences.zh: 按《爾雅》有考妣、王父母、曾祖王父母、高祖王父母及世父之別。

translations.literal: According to the Erya, there are distinctions among father and mother, royal grandparents, great-grandparents, great-great-grandparents, and father's elder brother.
translations.idiomatic: The Erya distinguishes father and mother, royal grandparents, great-grandparents, great-great-grandparents, and father's elder brother.

sentences.zh: 以此觀之，唯父母得稱 考妣。

translations.literal: Viewed in this light, only parents may be addressed as father and mother.
translations.idiomatic: On this reading, only one's own parents may properly be called father and mother.

sentences.zh: 今請僖祖止稱廟號，順祖而下，即依《爾雅》之文。」

translations.literal: We now request that Xizu be addressed only by temple name; from Shunzu downward, let the Erya's terminology be followed."
translations.idiomatic: We propose that Xizu be addressed only by temple name, and that from Shunzu downward the Erya's terms be used."

sentences.zh: 事下尚書省議，戶部尚書張齊賢等言：「《王制》『天子七廟』。

translations.literal: The matter was referred to the Department of State Affairs for deliberation. Zhang Qixian, Minister of Revenue, and others stated: "The Royal Regulations say, 'The Son of Heaven has seven temples.
translations.idiomatic: The matter went to the Department of State Affairs. Zhang Qixian, Minister of Revenue, and others argued: "The Royal Regulations state that the Son of Heaven maintains seven temples.

sentences.zh: 謂三昭三穆與太祖之廟而七。

translations.literal: This means three zhao, three mu, and the temple of the Grand Ancestor—seven in all.
translations.idiomatic: This means three zhao, three mu, and the Grand Ancestor's shrine—seven in all.

sentences.zh: 前代或 有兄弟繼及，亦移昭穆之列，是以《漢書》『為人後者為之子』，所以尊本祖而重正統也。

translations.literal: In former ages there were sometimes successions between brothers, and the zhao-mu ranks were also shifted accordingly; hence the Book of Han: 'One who becomes another's heir is considered his son'—thereby honoring one's original ancestor and affirming the legitimate succession.
translations.idiomatic: When brothers succeeded one another in earlier dynasties, the zhao-mu arrangement shifted accordingly; hence the Book of Han's rule that an heir is treated as a son—honoring the original line and affirming legitimate succession.

sentences.zh: 又《禮》云：『天子絕期喪。』

translations.literal: The Rites also say: 'The Son of Heaven terminates mourning at one year.'
translations.idiomatic: The Rites also state that the Son of Heaven ends mourning at one year.

sentences.zh: 安得宗廟中有伯氏之稱乎？

translations.literal: How then can there be an address of elder uncle in the ancestral temple?
translations.idiomatic: How then can the ancestral temple include an address of elder uncle?

sentences.zh: 其唐及五代有 所稱者，蓋禮官之失，非正典也。

translations.literal: Where Tang and the Five Dynasties used such terms, it was the error of ritual officials, not proper canonical practice.
translations.idiomatic: Where Tang and the Five Dynasties used such terms, it reflected ritual officials' errors, not canonical precedent.

sentences.zh: 請自今有事於太廟，則太祖並諸祖室，稱孝孫、孝曾孫嗣皇帝；

translations.literal: We request that henceforth, when rites are performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, before Taizu and all the ancestral shrines the emperor be styled Filial Grandson, Filial Great-Grandson, and Heir Emperor;
translations.idiomatic: We propose that henceforth, at rites in the ancestral temple, before Taizu and the earlier ancestral shrines the emperor be styled Filial Grandson, Filial Great-Grandson, and Heir Emperor;

sentences.zh: 太宗室，稱孝子嗣皇帝。

translations.literal: before the Taizong shrine, Filial Son and Heir Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: and before Taizong's shrine, Filial Son and Heir Emperor.

sentences.zh: 其《爾雅》『考妣』、『王父』之文，本 不為宗廟言也。

translations.literal: The Erya's passages on 'father and mother' and 'royal grandfather' were never intended for ancestral-temple usage.
translations.idiomatic: The Erya's terms for father, mother, and royal grandfather were never meant for ancestral-temple address.

sentences.zh: 歷代既無所取，於今亦不可行。」

translations.literal: Former dynasties did not adopt them; they cannot be implemented today."
translations.idiomatic: No dynasty properly adopted them, and they cannot be implemented now."

sentences.zh: 詔下禮官議。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the ritual officials to deliberate.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered the ritual officials to deliberate.

sentences.zh: 議曰：「按《春秋正義》『躋魯僖公』云：『禮，父子異昭穆，兄弟昭、穆同。』

translations.literal: Their deliberation stated: "According to the Correct Meaning of the Spring and Autumn Annals on 'Elevating Duke Xi of Lu': 'By ritual, father and son occupy different zhao and mu; brothers share the same zhao and mu.
translations.idiomatic: They replied: "The Correct Meaning of the Spring and Autumn Annals, on elevating Duke Xi of Lu, states that by ritual father and son occupy different zhao and mu, while brothers share the same zhao and mu.

sentences.zh: 此明 兄弟繼統，同為一代。

translations.literal: This shows that when brothers succeed in succession, they count as one generation.
translations.idiomatic: This shows that when brothers succeed one another, they count as one generation.

sentences.zh: 又魯隱、桓繼及，皆當穆位。

translations.literal: Moreover, when Duke Yin and Duke Huan of Lu succeeded one another, both occupied the mu position.
translations.idiomatic: When Duke Yin and Duke Huan of Lu succeeded each other, both occupied the mu position.

sentences.zh: 又《尚書》盤庚有商及王，《史記》雲陽甲至小乙兄弟四人相承，故不稱嗣子而曰及王，明不繼兄之統也。

translations.literal: The Book of Documents, Pan Geng section, speaks of Shang kings who succeeded one another; the Records of the Grand Historian says that from Yang Jia to Xiao Yi four brothers succeeded in turn, hence they were not called heir sons but kings who succeeded—showing that they did not inherit a brother's line.
translations.idiomatic: The Book of Documents' Pan Geng section speaks of Shang kings who succeeded one another; Sima Qian notes that from Yang Jia to Xiao Yi four brothers ruled in succession and were styled kings who succeeded rather than heir sons—showing they did not inherit a brother's line.

sentences.zh: 又唐 中、睿皆處昭位，敬、文、武昭穆同為一世。

translations.literal: Moreover, Tang's Zhongzong and Ruizong both occupied zhao positions; Gaozu, Wen, and Wu shared zhao and mu as one generation.
translations.idiomatic: Tang's Zhongzong and Ruizong both occupied zhao positions, while Gaozu, Wen, and Wu shared zhao and mu as one generation.

sentences.zh: 伏請僖祖室止稱廟號，後曰祖妣，順祖室曰高祖，後曰高祖妣，翼祖室曰曾祖，後曰曾祖妣，祝文皆稱孝曾孫。

translations.literal: We humbly request that the Xizu shrine be addressed only by temple name, the consort as ancestral grandmother; the Shunzu shrine as great-great-grandfather, the consort as great-great-grandmother; the Yizu shrine as great-grandfather, the consort as great-grandmother—with all prayer texts styled Filial Great-Grandson.
translations.idiomatic: We propose: the Xizu shrine addressed only by temple name, the consort as ancestral grandmother; Shunzu as great-great-grandfather, the consort as great-great-grandmother; Yizu as great-grandfather, the consort as great-grandmother—with all prayer texts styled Filial Great-Grandson.

sentences.zh: 宣祖室 曰皇祖考，後曰皇祖妣，祝文稱孝孫。

translations.literal: The Xuanzu shrine as Imperial Grandfather, the consort as Imperial Grandmother, prayer texts styled Filial Grandson.
translations.idiomatic: The Xuanzu shrine as Imperial Grandfather, the consort as Imperial Grandmother, prayer texts styled Filial Grandson.

sentences.zh: 太祖室曰皇伯考妣，太宗室曰皇考妣。

translations.literal: The Taizu shrine as Imperial Elder Uncle and Consort; the Taizong shrine as Imperial Father and Mother.
translations.idiomatic: The Taizu shrine as Imperial Elder Uncle and Consort; the Taizong shrine as Imperial Father and Mother.

sentences.zh: 每大祭，太祖、太宗昭、穆同位，祝文並稱孝子。

translations.literal: At each great sacrifice, Taizu and Taizong share zhao and mu in the same position; prayer texts uniformly style Filial Son.
translations.idiomatic: At each great sacrifice, Taizu and Taizong share zhao and mu in the same position, with prayer texts uniformly styled Filial Son.

sentences.zh: 其別廟稱謂，亦請依此。」

translations.literal: The designations for separate shrines should likewise follow this."
translations.idiomatic: Separate-shrine designations should follow the same rule."

sentences.zh: 詔都省復集議，曰：「古者，祖有功，宗有德，皆先有其實而後正其名。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Imperial Secretariat to reconvene for deliberation, stating: "In antiquity, 'zu' honored merit and 'zong' honored virtue—each first had the substance and only then received the correct name.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered the Imperial Secretariat to reconvene, arguing: "In antiquity, zu honored merit and zong honored virtue—substance came first, title afterward.

sentences.zh: 今太祖受命開基，太宗纘承大寶，則百世不祧之廟矣。

translations.literal: Now Taizu received the Mandate and founded the dynasty; Taizong continued the great inheritance—they are temples never to be displaced for a hundred generations.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu received the Mandate and founded the dynasty; Taizong continued the great inheritance—they are shrines never to be displaced for a hundred generations.

sentences.zh: 豈有祖宗之廟已分二世，昭穆之位 翻為一代？

translations.literal: How can the ancestral temples already be divided into two generations, yet the zhao-mu positions be reversed into one generation?
translations.idiomatic: How can the ancestral temples already span two generations, yet the zhao-mu arrangement be collapsed into one?

sentences.zh: 如臣等議，禮『為人後者為之子』，以正父子之道，以定昭、穆之義，則無疑也。

translations.literal: As we ministers deliberate, the ritual 'one who becomes another's heir is considered his son' rectifies the way of father and son and fixes the meaning of zhao and mu—there can be no doubt.
translations.idiomatic: As we see it, the ritual rule that an heir is treated as a son rectifies the father-son relationship and fixes zhao and mu—leaving no doubt.

sentences.zh: 必若同為一代，則太宗不得自為世數，而何以得為宗乎？

translations.literal: If they must count as one generation, then Taizong cannot constitute his own generation-count—how then can he be a zong?
translations.idiomatic: If they count as one generation, Taizong cannot constitute his own generation—how then can he be a zong?

sentences.zh: 不得為宗，又 何以得為百世不祧之主乎？

translations.literal: If he cannot be a zong, how can he be a lord never displaced for a hundred generations?
translations.idiomatic: If he cannot be a zong, how can he be a lord never displaced for a hundred generations?

sentences.zh: 《春秋正義》亦不言昭。

translations.literal: The Correct Meaning of the Spring and Autumn Annals also does not say that zhao
translations.idiomatic: The Correct Meaning of the Spring and Autumn Annals also does not say that zhao

sentences.zh: 穆不可異，此又不可以為證也。

translations.literal: and mu cannot differ—this too cannot serve as evidence.
translations.idiomatic: and mu cannot differ—this too cannot serve as evidence.

sentences.zh: 今若序為六世，以一昭一穆言之，則上無毀廟之嫌，下有善繼之美，於禮為大 順，於時為合宜，何嫌而謂不可乎？」

translations.literal: If we now arrange six generations, speaking in terms of one zhao and one mu, then above there is no suspicion of destroying temples, and below there is the excellence of good succession—in ritual this is greatly compliant, and for the times it is fitting. What objection can there be to calling it impermissible?"
translations.idiomatic: If we arrange six generations with one zhao and one mu, there is no suspicion of destroying temples above and the merit of orderly succession below—greatly compliant with ritual and fitting for the times. What objection can there be?

sentences.zh: 翰林學士宋湜言：「三代而下，兄弟相繼則多，昭、穆異位，未之見也。

translations.literal: Hanlin Academician Song Wo stated: "From the Three Dynasties downward, brotherly succession has been common, but zhao and mu in different positions—this we have never seen.
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin Academician Song Wo objected: "Since the Three Dynasties, brotherly succession has been common, but zhao and mu in different positions—this we have never seen.

sentences.zh: 今詳都省所議，皇帝於太祖室稱孫，竊有疑焉。」

translations.literal: Examining the Imperial Secretariat's deliberation in detail, that the emperor before the Taizu shrine should be styled grandson—I have private doubts."
translations.idiomatic: Reviewing the Secretariat's proposal that the emperor be styled grandson before Taizu's shrine, I have serious doubts."

sentences.zh: 詔令禮官再議。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the ritual officials to deliberate again.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered the ritual officials to deliberate again.

sentences.zh: 禮官言：「按《祭統》曰：『祭有昭、穆者，所以別父子遠近長幼親疏之序而無亂也。』

translations.literal: The ritual officials stated: "According to the Record of Sacrifices: 'Sacrifices have zhao and mu in order to distinguish the order of father and son, near and far, elder and younger, close and distant, without confusion.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual officials replied: "The Record of Sacrifices states that sacrifices employ zhao and mu to distinguish the order of father and son, near and far, elder and younger, close and distant, without confusion.

sentences.zh: 《公羊傳》，公孫嬰齊為兄歸父之後，《春秋》謂之仲嬰 齊。

translations.literal: The Gongyang Commentary: Gongsun Yingqi became heir to his elder brother Gui Fu; the Spring and Autumn Annals calls him Zhong Yingqi.
translations.idiomatic: The Gongyang Commentary notes that Gongsun Yingqi became heir to his elder brother Gui Fu; the Spring and Autumn Annals calls him Zhong Yingqi.

sentences.zh: 何休云：『弟無後兄之義，為亂昭穆之序，失父子之親，故不言仲孫，明不以子為父孫。』

translations.literal: He Xiu says: 'A younger brother has no right to succeed an elder brother—it disrupts the zhao-mu order and loses the intimacy of father and son; hence it does not say Zhong Sun, making clear that one does not treat a son as father and grandson.'"
translations.idiomatic: He Xiu explains that a younger brother has no right to succeed an elder brother—it disrupts zhao-mu and loses the father-son bond; hence the text does not say Zhongsun, making clear that a son is not treated as father and grandson."

sentences.zh: 晉賀循議兄弟不合繼位昭穆云：『商人六廟，親廟四，並契、湯而 六，比有兄弟四人相襲為君者，便當上毀四廟乎？

translations.literal: Jin He Xun, deliberating that brothers should not succeed in zhao-mu positions, said: 'The Shang had six temples, four direct-line temples together with Qi and Tang—six in all. If four brothers succeeded one another as rulers, should the four temples above be destroyed?
translations.idiomatic: Jin He Xun argued that brothers should not succeed in zhao-mu positions: 'The Shang had six temples—four direct-line plus Qi and Tang. If four brothers ruled in succession, should the four upper temples be destroyed?

sentences.zh: 如此，四世之親盡，無復祖禰之神矣。』

translations.literal: If so, affection for four generations would be exhausted, and there would be no more spirits of ancestors and fathers.
translations.idiomatic: If so, affection for four generations would be exhausted and the spirits of ancestors and fathers would be lost.

sentences.zh: 溫嶠議兄弟相繼、藏主夾室之事云：『若以一帝為一世，則當不得祭於 禰，乃不及庶人之祭也。』

translations.literal: Wen Jiao, deliberating on brotherly succession and storing tablets in flanking chambers, said: 'If each emperor counts as one generation, then one could not sacrifice to one's father—falling short even of a commoner's sacrifices.'"
translations.idiomatic: Wen Jiao, on brotherly succession and storing tablets in flanking chambers, argued: 'If each emperor counts as one generation, one could not sacrifice to one's father—falling short even of a commoner's rites.'"

sentences.zh: 夫兄弟同世，於恩既順，於義無否。

translations.literal: Brothers in the same generation accord with affection and violate no principle of right.
translations.idiomatic: Brothers in the same generation accord with affection and violate no principle of right.

sentences.zh: 玄宗朝禘袷，皇伯考中宗、皇考睿宗同列於穆位。

translations.literal: At the di and xia sacrifices in Xuanzong's reign, Imperial Elder Uncle Zhongzong and Imperial Father Ruizong were ranked together in the mu position.
translations.idiomatic: At the di and xia sacrifices under Xuanzong, Imperial Elder Uncle Zhongzong and Imperial Father Ruizong were ranked together in the mu position.

sentences.zh: 德宗亦以中宗為高伯祖。

translations.literal: Dezong likewise addressed Zhongzong as great-great-grand elder uncle.
translations.idiomatic: Dezong likewise addressed Zhongzong as great-great-grand elder uncle.

sentences.zh: 晉王導、荀崧議『大宗無 子，則立支子』，又曰『為人後者為之子』，無兄弟相為之文。

translations.literal: Jin Wang Dao and Xun Song deliberated: 'If the major line has no son, establish a branch son,' and also said 'one who becomes another's heir is considered his son'—there is no text on brothers succeeding one another.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Wang Dao and Xun Song held that if the major line has no son, a branch son is established, and that an heir is treated as a son—nowhere do they authorize brother succeeding brother.

sentences.zh: 所以舍至親取遠屬者，蓋以兄弟一體，無父子之道故也。

translations.literal: The reason for setting aside the closest kin and taking a distant collateral was that brothers are one body and lack the way of father and son.
translations.idiomatic: They set aside the closest kin for a distant collateral because brothers are one body and lack the father-son bond.

sentences.zh: 竊以七廟之制，百王是尊。

translations.literal: We hold that the system of seven temples is honored by a hundred kings.
translations.idiomatic: The seven-temple system has been honored by a hundred kings.

sentences.zh: 至於祖有功，宗 有德，則百世不遷之廟也；

translations.literal: As for 'zu honors merit, zong honors virtue'—these are temples never moved for a hundred generations;
translations.idiomatic: Zu honors merit and zong honors virtue—these are shrines never moved for a hundred generations;

sentences.zh: 父為昭，子為穆，則千古不刊之典也。

translations.literal: father as zhao, son as mu—this is the canon never altered for a thousand ages.
translations.idiomatic: father as zhao, son as mu—this is the canon never altered for a thousand ages.

sentences.zh: 今議者引《漢書》曰：『為人後者為之子。』

translations.literal: Those who deliberate now cite the Book of Han: 'One who becomes another's heir is considered his son.'
translations.idiomatic: Those who argue now cite the Book of Han: 'One who becomes another's heir is considered his son.'

sentences.zh: 殊不知弟不為兄後，子不為父孫，《春秋》之深旨。

translations.literal: They do not realize that a younger brother does not succeed an elder brother, and a son is not father and grandson—the deep purport of the Spring and Autumn Annals.
translations.idiomatic: They overlook the Spring and Autumn Annals' deep teaching: a younger brother does not succeed an elder brother, and a son is not father and grandson.

sentences.zh: 父謂之昭，子謂之穆，《禮記》之明文也。

translations.literal: Father is called zhao, son is called mu—the explicit text of the Record of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Father is called zhao, son is called mu—the explicit text of the Record of Rites.

sentences.zh: 又按太宗享祀太祖二十有二載，稱曰『孝弟』，此不易之制，又安可追改乎？

translations.literal: Moreover, Taizong sacrificed to Taizu for twenty-two years, styled 'Filial Younger Brother'—this is an unchanging institution; how can it be retroactively altered?
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, Taizong sacrificed to Taizu for twenty-two years as 'Filial Younger Brother'—an established institution that cannot be retroactively altered.

sentences.zh: 唐玄宗謂中宗為皇伯考，德宗謂中宗為高伯 祖，則伯氏之稱，復何不可？

translations.literal: Tang Xuanzong called Zhongzong Imperial Elder Uncle; Dezong called Zhongzong great-great-grand elder uncle—why then cannot the address of elder uncle be used?
translations.idiomatic: Tang Xuanzong called Zhongzong Imperial Elder Uncle; Dezong called him great-great-grand elder uncle—why then cannot the address of elder uncle be used?

sentences.zh: 臣等參議：自今合祭日，太祖、太宗依典禮同位異坐，皇帝於太祖仍稱孝子，餘並遵舊制。」

translations.literal: We ministers jointly deliberate: from this day at combined sacrifices, Taizu and Taizong shall follow canonical ritual in the same position with separate seats; the emperor before Taizu shall still be styled Filial Son; all else shall follow the former regulations."
translations.idiomatic: We jointly recommend: at combined sacrifices from this day forward, Taizu and Taizong shall share the same position with separate seats per canonical ritual; the emperor before Taizu shall still be styled Filial Son; all else shall follow former regulations."

sentences.zh: 乾興元年十月，奉真宗神主祔廟，以章 穆皇后郭氏配。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the first year of Qianxing, Zhenzong's spirit tablet was installed in the temple; Empress Zhangmu, née Guo, was associated in the shrine.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of 1022, Zhenzong's spirit tablet was installed in the temple, with Empress Zhangmu (née Guo) enshrined alongside.

sentences.zh: 康定元年，直秘閣趙希言奏：「太廟自來有寢無廟，因堂為室，東西十六間，內十四間為七室，兩首各一夾室。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kangding, Zhao Xiyan of the Direct Secretariat memorialized: "The Imperial Ancestral Temple has always had a rest hall but no separate temple hall; chambers were made from the main hall. East and west, sixteen bays; within, fourteen bays form seven chambers, with one flanking chamber at each end.
translations.idiomatic: In 1040, Zhao Xiyan of the Direct Secretariat memorialized: "The ancestral temple has always had a rest hall but no separate temple hall, with chambers carved from the main hall—sixteen bays east and west, fourteen forming seven chambers, with one flanking chamber at each end.

sentences.zh: 按禮，天子七廟，親廟五、祧廟二。

translations.literal: According to ritual, the Son of Heaven has seven temples—five direct-line temples and two distant-line temples.
translations.idiomatic: By ritual, the Son of Heaven maintains seven temples—five direct-line and two distant-line.

sentences.zh: 據古則僖、順二神當遷。

translations.literal: According to antiquity, the spirits of Xi and Shun should be moved.
translations.idiomatic: By ancient rule, the spirits of Xi and Shun should be moved.

sentences.zh: 國家道觀佛寺，並建別殿，奉安神御，豈若每主為一廟一寢。

translations.literal: The state's Daoist abbeys and Buddhist temples each build separate halls to enshrine imperial spirit images—how much better if each sovereign had one temple and one rest hall.
translations.idiomatic: State Daoist abbeys and Buddhist temples each build separate halls for imperial spirit images—how much better if each sovereign had one temple and one rest hall.

sentences.zh: 或前立一廟，以今十六間為寢，更立一祧廟，逐室各題廟號。

translations.literal: Or build a temple hall in front, use the present sixteen bays as the rest hall, and build a separate distant-line temple, inscribing each chamber with its temple name.
translations.idiomatic: Or build a temple hall in front, use the present sixteen bays as the rest hall, and erect a separate distant-line temple, inscribing each chamber with its temple name.

sentences.zh: 釦寶神御物，宜 銷毀之。」

translations.literal: Spirit-image treasures and objects should be destroyed."
translations.idiomatic: Spirit-image treasures and objects should be destroyed."

sentences.zh: 同判太常寺宋祁言：「周制有廟有寢，以象人君前有朝後有寢也。

translations.literal: Song Qi, acting head of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, stated: "Under Zhou regulations there were both temple and rest hall, symbolizing that the ruler had a court in front and a resting chamber behind.
translations.idiomatic: Song Qi, acting director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, replied: "Under Zhou regulations there were both temple and rest hall, symbolizing the ruler's court in front and private quarters behind.

sentences.zh: 廟藏木主，寢藏衣冠。

translations.literal: The temple stored wooden spirit tablets; the rest hall stored robes and caps.
translations.idiomatic: The temple stored wooden spirit tablets; the rest hall stored robes and caps.

sentences.zh: 至秦乃出寢於墓側，故陵上更稱寢殿，後世因之。

translations.literal: Only in Qin was the rest hall moved beside the tomb; hence on the mausoleum mound it came to be called the rest hall, and later ages followed this.
translations.idiomatic: Only under Qin was the rest hall moved beside the tomb; hence mausoleum mounds came to be called rest halls, and later ages followed suit.

sentences.zh: 今宗廟無寢， 蓋本於茲。

translations.literal: That the ancestral temple today has no rest hall derives from this.
translations.idiomatic: That today's ancestral temple has no rest hall derives from this.

sentences.zh: 鄭康成謂周制立二昭二穆，與太祖、文、武共為七廟，此一家之說，未足援正。

translations.literal: Zheng Xuan said that under Zhou regulations two zhao and two mu together with the Grand Ancestor, King Wen, and King Wu made seven temples—this is one school's opinion, insufficient to cite as authority.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Xuan held that Zhou practice placed two zhao and two mu together with the Grand Ancestor, King Wen, and King Wu as seven temples—one school's opinion, insufficient as authority.

sentences.zh: 自荀卿、王肅等皆云天子七廟，諸侯五，大夫三，士一，降殺以兩。

translations.literal: From Xunzi, Wang Su, and others, all say the Son of Heaven has seven temples, feudal lords five, grand masters three, officers one—descending by twos.
translations.idiomatic: From Xunzi and Wang Su onward, all hold that the Son of Heaven has seven temples, feudal lords five, grand masters three, officers one—descending by twos.

sentences.zh: 則國 家七世之數，不用康成之說也。

translations.literal: Thus the state's count of seven generations does not use Zheng Kangcheng's theory.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the state's count of seven generations does not follow Zheng Kangcheng's theory.

sentences.zh: 僖祖至真宗方及六世，不應便立祧廟。

translations.literal: From Xizu to Zhenzong there are only six generations; a distant-line temple should not yet be established.
translations.idiomatic: From Xizu to Zhenzong there are only six generations; a distant-line temple should not yet be established.

sentences.zh: 自周、漢每帝各立廟，晉、宋以來多同殿異室，國朝以七室代七廟，相承已久，不可輕改。

translations.literal: From Zhou and Han, each emperor established a separate temple; from Jin and Song onward many used one hall with separate chambers. Our dynasty uses seven chambers in place of seven temples—a practice long inherited that cannot lightly be altered.
translations.idiomatic: From Zhou and Han each emperor had his own temple; from Jin and Song onward most used one hall with separate chambers. Our dynasty substitutes seven chambers for seven temples—a practice long established that cannot lightly be changed.

sentences.zh: 《周禮》：『天府掌祖廟之守藏。』

translations.literal: The Rites of Zhou: 'The Celestial Repository oversees the safekeeping of the ancestral temple's stored treasures.'
translations.idiomatic: The Rites of Zhou states that the Celestial Repository oversees the ancestral temple's stored treasures.

sentences.zh: 寶物世傳者皆在焉。

translations.literal: Treasures handed down through the ages are all kept there.
translations.idiomatic: Treasures handed down through the ages are all kept there.

sentences.zh: 其神御法物、寶盝、釦床，請別為庫藏之。」

translations.literal: The spirit-image ritual objects, treasure cases, and inlaid beds—we request that these be stored in a separate repository."
translations.idiomatic: The spirit-image ritual objects, treasure cases, and inlaid beds should be stored in a separate repository.

sentences.zh: 自是室題廟號，而建神御庫焉。

translations.literal: Thereafter each chamber was inscribed with its temple name, and the Spirit-Image Repository was built.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter each chamber was inscribed with its temple name, and the Spirit-Image Repository was established.

sentences.zh: 嘉祐年，仁宗將 祔廟，修奉太廟使蔡襄上八室圖，為十八間。

translations.literal: In the Jiayou period, when Renzong was about to be enshrined in the temple, Cai Xiang, commissioner for maintaining the Imperial Ancestral Temple, submitted a diagram of eight chambers totaling eighteen bays.
translations.idiomatic: During the Jiayou period, as Renzong was about to be enshrined, Cai Xiang, commissioner for the ancestral temple, submitted a plan for eight chambers in eighteen bays.

sentences.zh: 初，禮院請增廟室，孫抃等以為：「七世之廟，據父子而言，兄弟則昭、穆同，不得以世數之。

translations.literal: Initially the Court of Ritual requested additional temple chambers. Sun Bian and others held: "The temple of seven generations is reckoned by father and son; brothers share the same zhao and mu and cannot be counted by generation number.
translations.idiomatic: Initially the Court of Ritual requested additional chambers. Sun Bian and others argued that the seven-generation temple is reckoned by father and son; brothers share zhao and mu and cannot be counted by generation number.

sentences.zh: 廟有始祖、有太祖、有 太宗、有中宗。

translations.literal: Temples have a founding ancestor, a Grand Ancestor, a Great Ancestor, and a Central Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Temples distinguish a founding ancestor, a Grand Ancestor, a Great Ancestor, and a Central Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 若以一君為一世，則小乙之祭不及其父。

translations.literal: If each ruler counts as one generation, then Xiao Yi's sacrifices would not reach his father.
translations.idiomatic: If each ruler counts as one generation, Xiao Yi's sacrifices would not reach his father.

sentences.zh: 故晉之廟十一室而六世，唐之廟十一室而九世。

translations.literal: Hence Jin's temple had eleven chambers for six generations; Tang's temple had eleven chambers for nine generations.
translations.idiomatic: Hence Jin's temple had eleven chambers spanning six generations; Tang's had eleven chambers spanning nine.

sentences.zh: 國朝太祖之室，太宗稱孝弟，真宗稱孝子，大行稱孝孫。

translations.literal: In our dynasty's Taizu shrine, Taizong was styled Filial Younger Brother, Zhenzong Filial Son, and the late emperor Filial Grandson.
translations.idiomatic: In our dynasty, before Taizu's shrine Taizong was styled Filial Younger Brother, Zhenzong Filial Son, and the late emperor Filial Grandson.

sentences.zh: 而 《禘袷圖》：太祖、太宗同居昭位，南向；

translations.literal: Yet the Diagram of Di and Xia Sacrifices shows Taizu and Taizong sharing the zhao position, facing south;
translations.idiomatic: Yet the Diagram of Di and Xia Sacrifices shows Taizu and Taizong sharing the zhao position, facing south;

sentences.zh: 真宗居穆位，北向。

translations.literal: Zhenzong in the mu position, facing north.
translations.idiomatic: with Zhenzong in the mu position, facing north.

sentences.zh: 蓋先朝稽用古禮，著之祀典。

translations.literal: The former court examined and applied ancient ritual, recording it in the sacrificial canon.
translations.idiomatic: The former court had examined ancient ritual and recorded it in the sacrificial canon.

sentences.zh: 大行神主祔廟，請增為八室，以備天子事七世之禮。」

translations.literal: When the late emperor's spirit tablet is installed in the temple, we request expansion to eight chambers to fulfill the Son of Heaven's rite of serving seven generations."
translations.idiomatic: When the late emperor's tablet is installed, we request expansion to eight chambers to fulfill the Son of Heaven's rite of seven generations.

sentences.zh: 盧士宗、司馬光 以為：「太祖已上之主，雖屬尊於太祖，親盡則遷。

translations.literal: Lu Shizong and Sima Guang held: "The lords above Taizu, though senior to Taizu in rank, are moved when affection is exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Shizong and Sima Guang argued that lords above Taizu, though senior in rank, are moved when affection is exhausted.

sentences.zh: 故漢元之世，太上廟主瘞於寢園；

translations.literal: Hence in Emperor Yuan of Han's time, the Supreme Temple tablets were buried in the rest-hall garden;
translations.idiomatic: In Emperor Yuan of Han's time, Supreme Temple tablets were buried in the rest-hall garden;

sentences.zh: 魏明之世，處士廟主遷於園邑；

translations.literal: in Emperor Ming of Wei's time, the Commoner Temple tablets were moved to the garden settlement;
translations.idiomatic: in Emperor Ming of Wei's time, Commoner Temple tablets were moved to the garden settlement;

sentences.zh: 晉武祔廟，遷征西府君；

translations.literal: when Emperor Wu of Jin enshrined tablets, Lord of the Western Campaign was moved;
translations.idiomatic: when Emperor Wu of Jin enshrined tablets, the Lord of the Western Campaign was moved;

sentences.zh: 惠帝祔廟，遷豫章府 君。

translations.literal: when Emperor Hui enshrined tablets, Lord of Yuzhang Prefecture was moved.
translations.idiomatic: when Emperor Hui enshrined tablets, the Lord of Yuzhang was moved.

sentences.zh: 自是以下，大抵過六世則遷。

translations.literal: From this downward, generally beyond six generations there was movement.
translations.idiomatic: From this point onward, generally beyond six generations tablets were moved.

sentences.zh: 蓋太祖未正東向，故上祀三昭三穆；

translations.literal: Because the Grand Ancestor had not yet faced east, three zhao and three mu were sacrificed to above;
translations.idiomatic: Because the Grand Ancestor had not yet faced east, three zhao and three mu were sacrificed above;

sentences.zh: 巳正東向，則並昭、穆為七世。

translations.literal: once he faced east, zhao and mu together made seven generations.
translations.idiomatic: once he faced east, zhao and mu together constituted seven generations.

sentences.zh: 唐初祀四世，太宗增祀六世。

translations.literal: Early Tang sacrificed to four generations; Taizong increased sacrifice to six generations.
translations.idiomatic: Early Tang sacrificed to four generations; Taizong increased it to six.

sentences.zh: 及太宗祔廟，則遷弘農府君，高 宗祔廟，又遷宣帝，皆祀六世，前世成法也。

translations.literal: When Taizong was enshrined, Lord of Hongnong was moved; when Gaozong was enshrined, Emperor Xuan was moved again—all sacrificing to six generations, the established law of former ages.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizong was enshrined, the Lord of Hongnong was moved; when Gaozong was enshrined, Emperor Xuan was moved again—all sacrificing to six generations, the established law of former ages.

sentences.zh: 玄宗立九室祀八世，事不經見。

translations.literal: Xuanzong established nine chambers to sacrifice to eight generations—a practice without precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzong established nine chambers for eight generations—a practice without precedent.

sentences.zh: 若以太祖、太宗為一世，則大行祔廟，僖祖親盡，當遷夾室，祀三昭三穆，於先王典禮 及近世之制，無不符合。」

translations.literal: If Taizu and Taizong count as one generation, then when the late emperor is enshrined, Xizu's affection is exhausted and he should be moved to a flanking chamber, sacrificing to three zhao and three mu—in ancient kings' canonical ritual and recent practice, nothing would fail to accord."
translations.idiomatic: If Taizu and Taizong count as one generation, when the late emperor is enshrined Xizu's affection is exhausted and he should move to a flanking chamber, sacrificing to three zhao and three mu—in full accord with ancient canonical ritual and recent practice.

sentences.zh: 抃等復議曰：「自唐至周，廟製不同，而皆七世。

translations.literal: Bian and others rebutted: "From Tang to Zhou, temple systems differed, yet all had seven generations.
translations.idiomatic: Bian and others rebutted that from Tang to Zhou temple systems differed, yet all maintained seven generations.

sentences.zh: 自周以上，所謂太祖，非始受命之主，特始封之君而已。

translations.literal: Before Zhou, what was called Grand Ancestor was not the first to receive the Mandate but merely the first enfeoffed lord.
translations.idiomatic: Before Zhou, Grand Ancestor meant not the first to receive the Mandate but merely the first enfeoffed lord.

sentences.zh: 今僖祖雖非始封之君，要為立 廟之祖，方廟數未過七世，遂毀其廟，遷其主，考之三代，禮未有此。

translations.literal: Now although Xizu was not the first enfeoffed lord, he is nonetheless the ancestor who established the temple. The temple count has not yet exceeded seven generations, yet his temple is destroyed and his tablet moved—examining the Three Dynasties, ritual never had this.
translations.idiomatic: Although Xizu was not the first enfeoffed lord, he is the ancestor who established the temple. The count has not yet exceeded seven generations, yet his temple would be destroyed and his tablet moved—nothing like this appears in the Three Dynasties.

sentences.zh: 漢、魏及唐一時之議，恐未合先王制禮之意。」

translations.literal: The deliberations of Han, Wei, and Tang at particular moments likely do not accord with the former kings' intent in establishing ritual."
translations.idiomatic: The deliberations of Han, Wei, and Tang at particular moments likely do not accord with the former kings' intent in establishing ritual.

sentences.zh: 乃存僖祖室以備七室。

translations.literal: Thereupon Xizu's chamber was retained to complete seven chambers.
translations.idiomatic: Xizu's chamber was therefore retained to complete seven chambers.

sentences.zh: 治平四年，英宗將祔廟，太常禮院請以神主祔第八室，祧藏僖祖及文懿皇后神主於西夾室。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhiping, as Yingzong was about to be enshrined, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices requested that the spirit tablet be installed in the eighth chamber and that Xizu and Empress Wenyi's tablets be stored in distant-line fashion in the west flanking chamber.
translations.idiomatic: In 1067, as Yingzong was about to be enshrined, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices requested installation in the eighth chamber and distant-line storage of Xizu and Empress Wenyi's tablets in the west flanking chamber.

sentences.zh: 自仁宗而上，以次遞遷。

translations.literal: From Renzong upward, each was moved in succession.
translations.idiomatic: From Renzong upward, each shrine was shifted in succession.

sentences.zh: 翰林承旨張方平等議：「同堂八室，廟製已定，僖祖當祧，合於典禮。」

translations.literal: Hanlin Academician Recipient Zhang Fangping and others deliberated: "Eight chambers in one hall—the temple system is fixed; Xizu should be moved to distant-line status, in accord with canonical ritual."
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin Academician Recipient Zhang Fangping and others held that with eight chambers in one hall the system was fixed, Xizu should move to distant-line status, and this accorded with canonical ritual.

sentences.zh: 乃於九月奉安八室神主，祧僖祖及後，祔英宗，罷僖祖諱及文懿皇后忌日。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the eight-chamber spirit tablets were installed; Xizu and his consort were moved to distant-line status; Yingzong was enshrined; taboo on Xizu's name and Empress Wenyi's death anniversary were discontinued.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the eight-chamber tablets were installed; Xizu and his consort were moved to distant-line status; Yingzong was enshrined; and taboo on Xizu's name and Empress Wenyi's death anniversary were discontinued.

sentences.zh: 熙寧五年，中書門下言：「僖祖以上世次，不可得而知，則僖祖有廟，與商周契、稷疑無以異。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Xining, the Secretariat stated: "Generations above Xizu cannot be known; that Xizu has a temple scarcely differs from Shang and Zhou honoring Qi and Ji.
translations.idiomatic: In 1072, the Secretariat argued that generations above Xizu cannot be known, and that Xizu having a temple scarcely differs from Shang and Zhou honoring Qi and Ji.

sentences.zh: 今毀其廟而藏主夾室，替祖考之尊而下祔於子孫，殆非所以順祖宗孝心、事亡如存之義。

translations.literal: Now to destroy his temple and store the tablet in a flanking chamber, displacing the grandfather's honor and installing him below descendants—this scarcely accords with obeying the ancestors' filial intent and treating the dead as if living.
translations.idiomatic: To destroy his temple and store the tablet in a flanking chamber, displacing the grandfather's honor and installing him below descendants, scarcely accords with filial intent toward ancestors or treating the dead as if living.

sentences.zh: 請以所奏付兩製議，取其當者。」

translations.literal: We request that the memorial be referred to the Two Academies for deliberation, adopting what is correct."
translations.idiomatic: We request referral to the Two Academies for deliberation, adopting what is correct.

sentences.zh: 時王安石為相，不主祧遷之說，故復有是請。

translations.literal: At this time Wang Anshi was chief councilor and did not uphold the theory of distant-line movement; hence this request was made again.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Anshi was then chief councilor and did not uphold distant-line movement; hence this request was renewed.

sentences.zh: 翰林學士元絳等上議曰：「自古受命之王，既以功德享有天下，皆推其本統以尊事其祖。

translations.literal: Hanlin Academician Yuan Jiang and others submitted a deliberation: "From antiquity, kings who received the Mandate, having enjoyed the realm through merit and virtue, all traced their original line to honor their ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin Academician Yuan Jiang and others argued that from antiquity, Mandate-receiving kings who enjoyed the realm through merit and virtue all traced their original line to honor their ancestor.

sentences.zh: 故商、周以契、稷有功於唐、虞之際，故謂之祖有功，若必以有功而為 祖，則夏後氏不郊鯀矣。

translations.literal: Hence Shang and Zhou, because Qi and Ji had merit in the age of Tang and Yu, called them ancestors of merit; but if merit alone made one an ancestor, then the Xia would not have sacrificed at the border to Gun.
translations.idiomatic: Shang and Zhou honored Qi and Ji as ancestors of merit for their service in the age of Tang and Yu; but if merit alone made one an ancestor, the Xia would not have sacrificed at the border to Gun.

sentences.zh: 今太祖受命之初，立親廟，自僖祖以上世次，既不可知，則僖祖之為始祖無疑矣。

translations.literal: When Taizu first received the Mandate and established direct-line temples, generations above Xizu could not be known—then Xizu as founding ancestor is beyond doubt.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizu first received the Mandate and established direct-line temples, generations above Xizu could not be known—Xizu as founding ancestor is beyond doubt.

sentences.zh: 儻謂僖祖不當比契、稷為始祖，是使天下之人不復知尊 祖，而子孫得以有功加其祖考也。

translations.literal: If one says Xizu should not be compared to Qi and Ji as founding ancestor, this would make all under Heaven cease to know how to honor ancestors, and descendants could add merit to their forebears.
translations.idiomatic: To deny Xizu comparison with Qi and Ji as founding ancestor would make all under Heaven cease to honor ancestors properly, and let descendants add merit to their forebears at will.

sentences.zh: 《傳》曰：『毀廟之主，陳於太祖；

translations.literal: The Commentary says: 'Tablets of destroyed temples are displayed before the Grand Ancestor;
translations.idiomatic: The Commentary states that tablets of destroyed temples are displayed before the Grand Ancestor;

sentences.zh: 未毀廟之主，皆升，合食於太祖。』

translations.literal: tablets of temples not yet destroyed all ascend and share food with the Grand Ancestor.'
translations.idiomatic: and tablets of temples not yet destroyed all ascend and share food with the Grand Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 今遷僖祖之主，藏於太祖之室，則是四祖袷祭之日，皆降 而合食也。

translations.literal: Now to move Xizu's tablet and store it in Taizu's chamber means that on the day of the four ancestors' xia sacrifice, all descend and share food together.
translations.idiomatic: Moving Xizu's tablet into Taizu's chamber means that on the four ancestors' xia sacrifice day, all descend and share food together.

sentences.zh: 請以僖祖之廟為太祖，則合於先王禮意。」

translations.literal: We request that Xizu's temple be made the Grand Ancestor temple—this accords with the former kings' ritual intent."
translations.idiomatic: We propose making Xizu's temple the Grand Ancestor temple, in accord with the former kings' ritual intent.

sentences.zh: 翰林學士韓維議曰：「昔先王有天下，跡其基業之所起，奉以為太祖。

translations.literal: Hanlin Academician Han Wei deliberated: "Formerly when the former kings possessed the realm, they traced where their enterprise arose and honored it as Grand Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin Academician Han Wei argued that when former kings possessed the realm, they traced where their enterprise arose and honored it as Grand Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 故子夏序《詩》，稱文、武之功起於後 稷。

translations.literal: Hence Zixia, ordering the Odes, said the achievements of Wen and Wu arose from Hou Ji.
translations.idiomatic: Hence Zixia, ordering the Odes, said the achievements of Wen and Wu arose from Hou Ji.

sentences.zh: 後世有天下者，特起無所因，故遂為一代太祖。

translations.literal: Later ages' rulers who possessed the realm arose specially without precedent; hence they themselves became the Grand Ancestor of their generation.
translations.idiomatic: Later rulers who possessed the realm arose without precedent and themselves became their generation's Grand Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 太祖皇帝功德卓然，為宋太祖，無少議者。

translations.literal: Taizu Emperor's merit and virtue were outstanding; as Song's Grand Ancestor, none dispute this.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu Emperor's merit and virtue were outstanding; as Song's Grand Ancestor, none dispute this.

sentences.zh: 僖祖雖為高祖，然仰跡功業，未見所因，上尋世係，又不知所以始， 若以所事契、稷奉之，竊恐於古無考，而於今亦所未安。

translations.literal: Although Xizu was great-great-grandfather, tracing upward one finds no enterprise on which to rely; seeking the lineage upward, one does not know where it begins. To honor him as Qi and Ji were honored—I fear this lacks ancient warrant and is also unsettling today.
translations.idiomatic: Although Xizu was great-great-grandfather, tracing upward reveals no enterprise on which to rely and no known beginning to the lineage. To honor him as Qi and Ji were honored lacks ancient warrant and seems unsettling today.

sentences.zh: 今之廟室與古殊製，古者每廟異宮，今祖宗同處一室，則西夾室在順祖之右，考之尊卑之次，似亦無嫌。」

translations.literal: Today's temple chambers differ from antiquity's system; antiquity had each temple in a separate palace, but today ancestors share one chamber. The west flanking chamber is to Shunzu's right—examining the order of senior and junior, there seems no objection."
translations.idiomatic: Today's chambers differ from antiquity, when each temple had its own palace; today ancestors share one chamber. The west flanking chamber is to Shunzu's right—examining senior and junior order, there seems no objection.

sentences.zh: 天章閣待制孫固請：「特為僖祖立室，由太祖而上，親盡迭毀之主皆藏之。

translations.literal: Awaited Gentleman of the Hall of Heavenly Patterns Sun Gu requested: "Establish a special chamber for Xizu; from Taizu upward, all tablets whose affection is exhausted through successive destruction are stored there.
translations.idiomatic: Awaited Gentleman Sun Gu of the Hall of Heavenly Patterns proposed a special chamber for Xizu, storing from Taizu upward all tablets whose affection is exhausted through successive destruction.

sentences.zh: 當禘袷時，以僖祖權居東向之位，太祖順昭穆之列而從之，取毀廟之主而合食，則僖祖 之尊自有所申。

translations.literal: At di and xia sacrifices, let Xizu provisionally occupy the east-facing position; Taizu follows the zhao-mu ranks in attendance; take tablets of destroyed temples for combined food—then Xizu's honor is naturally expressed.
translations.idiomatic: At di and xia sacrifices, let Xizu provisionally face east while Taizu follows the zhao-mu ranks; combine food from destroyed temples—then Xizu's honor is naturally expressed.

sentences.zh: 以僖祖立廟為非，則周人別廟薑原，不可謂非禮。」

translations.literal: If establishing a temple for Xizu is wrong, then the Zhou people's separate temple for Jiang Yuan cannot be called unritual."
translations.idiomatic: If a separate temple for Xizu is wrong, then the Zhou's separate temple for Jiang Yuan cannot be called unritual.

sentences.zh: 秘閣校理王介請依《周官》守祧之制，創祧廟以奉僖祖，庶不下祔子孫夾室，以替遠祖之尊。

translations.literal: Secretariat Collator Wang Jie requested following the Rites of Zhou's system of guarding distant-line shrines, creating a distant-line temple to honor Xizu, so as not to install him below descendants in a flanking chamber and displace the remote ancestor's honor.
translations.idiomatic: Secretariat Collator Wang Jie proposed following the Rites of Zhou's system of guarding distant-line shrines, creating a distant-line temple for Xizu rather than installing him below descendants in a flanking chamber and displacing the remote ancestor's honor.

sentences.zh: 帝以維之說近是，而安石以維言夾室在右為尊為非理，帝亦然之。

translations.literal: The emperor held that Wei's view was nearly correct, but Wang Anshi held that Wei's saying the flanking chamber on the right was senior was unreasonable; the emperor agreed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor found Wei's view nearly correct, but Wang Anshi rejected Wei's claim that the right flanking chamber was senior; the emperor agreed with Wang.

sentences.zh: 又安石以尊僖祖為始祖，則郊祀當以配天，若宗祀明堂，則太祖、太宗當迭配帝。

translations.literal: Wang Anshi also held that honoring Xizu as founding ancestor meant border sacrifice should pair him with Heaven; if sacrificing at the Bright Hall, Taizu and Taizong should alternate as God's consorts.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Anshi also held that honoring Xizu as founding ancestor meant border sacrifice should pair him with Heaven, and that at the Bright Hall Taizu and Taizong should alternate as God's consorts.

sentences.zh: 又疑明堂以英宗配天，與僖祖為非始祖之說。

translations.literal: He also doubted pairing Yingzong with Heaven at the Bright Hall, which conflicted with the theory that Xizu was not founding ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: He also doubted pairing Yingzong with Heaven at the Bright Hall, which conflicted with denying Xizu as founding ancestor.

sentences.zh: 遂下禮官詳定。

translations.literal: An edict was issued for ritual officials to deliberate in detail.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered ritual officials to deliberate in detail.

sentences.zh: 同判太常寺兼禮儀事張師顏等議：「昔商、周之興，本於契、稷，故奉之為太祖。

translations.literal: Acting head of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Ritual Affairs Zhang Shiyan and others deliberated: "When Shang and Zhou arose, they rooted in Qi and Ji; hence these were honored as Grand Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Acting director Zhang Shiyan of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Ritual Affairs argued that Shang and Zhou arose from Qi and Ji and hence honored them as Grand Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 後世受命之君，功業特起，不因先代，則親廟迭毀，身自為祖。

translations.literal: Later Mandate-receiving rulers whose enterprise arose specially, not continuing a prior age, had direct-line temples successively destroyed and themselves became ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Later Mandate-receiving rulers whose enterprise arose without continuing a prior age had direct-line temples successively destroyed and themselves became ancestor.

sentences.zh: 鄭玄雲『夏五廟 無太祖，禹與二昭二穆而已』，張薦雲『夏後以禹始封，遂為不遷之祖』是也。

translations.literal: Zheng Xuan said, 'Xia's five temples had no Grand Ancestor—only Yu with two zhao and two mu'; Zhang Jian said, 'Xia took Yu at first enfeoffment as the ancestor never moved'—this is correct.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Xuan held that Xia's five temples had no Grand Ancestor—only Yu with two zhao and two mu; Zhang Jian held that Xia took Yu at first enfeoffment as the ancestor never moved—and this is correct.

sentences.zh: 若始封世近，上有親廟，則擬祖上遷，而太祖不毀。

translations.literal: If the first enfeoffment was recent and direct-line temples existed above, the putative ancestor was moved upward while the Grand Ancestor was not destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: If the first enfeoffment was recent and direct-line temples existed above, the putative ancestor was moved upward while the Grand Ancestor was not destroyed.

sentences.zh: 魏祖武帝則處士迭毀，唐祖景帝 則弘農迭毀，此前世祖其始封之君，以法契、稷之明例也。

translations.literal: Wei ancestor Emperor Wu had the Commoner successively destroyed; Tang ancestor Emperor Jing had Hongnong successively destroyed—these former ages honored their first enfeoffed lords, following Qi and Ji's clear precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Wei ancestor Emperor Wu had the Commoner successively destroyed; Tang ancestor Emperor Jing had Hongnong successively destroyed—these former ages honored their first enfeoffed lords, following Qi and Ji's clear precedent.

sentences.zh: 唐韓愈有言：『事異商、周，禮從而變。』

translations.literal: Tang's Han Yu said: 'When affairs differ from Shang and Zhou, ritual changes accordingly.'
translations.idiomatic: Han Yu of Tang said that when affairs differ from Shang and Zhou, ritual changes accordingly.

sentences.zh: 晉琅邪王德文曰：『七廟之義，自由德厚流光，享祀及遠，非 是為太祖申尊祖之祀。』

translations.literal: Jin's Prince Dewen of Langye said: 'The meaning of seven temples arises from virtue deep and radiance far-reaching, sacrifice reaching the remote—it is not to extend Grand Ancestor worship to honor ancestors.'
translations.idiomatic: Jin's Prince Dewen of Langye said that the meaning of seven temples arises from deep virtue and far-reaching radiance, sacrifice reaching the remote—not to extend Grand Ancestor worship to honor ancestors.

sentences.zh: 其說是也。

translations.literal: This theory is correct.
translations.idiomatic: This theory is correct.

sentences.zh: 禮，天子七廟，而太祖之遠近不可以必，但雲三昭三穆與太祖之廟而七，未嘗言親廣之首，必為始祖也。

translations.literal: By ritual the Son of Heaven has seven temples, but the Grand Ancestor's remoteness cannot be fixed; it only says three zhao, three mu, and the Grand Ancestor's temple make seven—it never says the head of the direct line must be founding ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: By ritual the Son of Heaven has seven temples, but the Grand Ancestor's remoteness cannot be fixed; ritual only says three zhao, three mu, and the Grand Ancestor's temple make seven—it never requires the head of the direct line to be founding ancestor.

sentences.zh: 國家以僖祖親盡而祧 之，奉景祐之詔，以太祖為帝者之祖，是合於禮矣。

translations.literal: The state moved Xizu to distant-line status when affection was exhausted, following the Jingyou edict making Taizu the emperor's ancestor—this accords with ritual.
translations.idiomatic: The state moved Xizu to distant-line status when affection was exhausted, following the Jingyou edict making Taizu the emperor's ancestor—in full accord with ritual.

sentences.zh: 張昭、任徹之徒，不能遠推隆極之制，因緣近比，請建四廟，遂使天子之禮下同諸侯。

translations.literal: Zhang Zhao, Ren Che, and their kind could not extend far the system of supreme elevation; drawing on recent comparison, they requested four temples, making the Son of Heaven's ritual the same as feudal lords.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhao, Ren Che, and their kind could not extend the system of supreme elevation; drawing on recent comparison they requested four temples, reducing the Son of Heaven's ritual to that of feudal lords.

sentences.zh: 若使廟數備六，則更當上 推兩世，而僖祖次在第三，亦未可謂之始祖也。

translations.literal: If temple count reached six, one must push two generations further up, and Xizu would rank third—he still could not be called founding ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: If temples reached six, one must push two generations further up, and Xizu would rank third—he still could not be called founding ancestor.

sentences.zh: 謹按建隆四年，親郊崇配不及僖祖。

translations.literal: We respectfully note that in the fourth year of Jianlong, at the border sacrifice the elevated pairing did not reach Xizu.
translations.idiomatic: We note that in 963, at the border sacrifice the elevated pairing did not reach Xizu.

sentences.zh: 開國以來，大祭虛其東向，斯乃祖宗已行之意。

translations.literal: Since the founding, great sacrifices have left the east-facing position vacant—this is the intent our ancestors already enacted.
translations.idiomatic: Since the founding, great sacrifices have left the east-facing position vacant—the intent our ancestors already enacted.

sentences.zh: 請略仿《周官》守祧之制，築別 廟以藏僖祖神主，大祭之歲，祀於其室。

translations.literal: We request roughly following the Rites of Zhou's system of guarding distant-line shrines, building a separate temple to store Xizu's spirit tablet, and in years of great sacrifice worshiping in its chamber.
translations.idiomatic: We propose roughly following the Rites of Zhou's system of guarding distant-line shrines, building a separate temple for Xizu's tablet and worshiping there in years of great sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 太廟則一依舊制，虛東向之位。

translations.literal: The Imperial Ancestral Temple should follow the former regulations entirely, leaving the east-facing position vacant.
translations.idiomatic: The ancestral temple should follow former regulations entirely, leaving the east-facing position vacant.

sentences.zh: 郊配之禮，則仍其舊。」

translations.literal: Border-sacrifice pairing ritual should remain as before."
translations.idiomatic: Border-sacrifice pairing should remain as before.

sentences.zh: 同知太常禮院蘇棁請：「即景靈宮祔僖祖，即與唐祔 獻、懿二祖於興聖、明德廟，禮意無異。」

translations.literal: Associate director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Su Chuo requested: "Enshrining Xizu at Jingling Palace is no different in ritual intent from Tang enshrining the Xian and Yi ancestors at the Xingsheng and Mingde temples."
translations.idiomatic: Associate director Su Chuo of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices proposed enshrining Xizu at Jingling Palace—no different in ritual intent from Tang enshrining the Xian and Yi ancestors at the Xingsheng and Mingde temples.

sentences.zh: 同判禮院周孟陽等言：「自僖祖而上，世次莫知，則僖祖為始祖無疑，宜以僖祖配感生帝。」

translations.literal: Acting head of the Court of Ritual Zhou Mengyang and others stated: "From Xizu upward, generations are unknown—then Xizu as founding ancestor is beyond doubt; he should be paired with the Life-Giving Emperor."
translations.idiomatic: Acting head Zhou Mengyang of the Court of Ritual argued that generations above Xizu are unknown, Xizu as founding ancestor is beyond doubt, and he should be paired with the Life-Giving Emperor.

sentences.zh: 章衡請：「尊僖祖為始祖， 而次祧順祖，以合子為父屈之義。

translations.literal: Zhang Heng requested: "Honor Xizu as founding ancestor and next move Shunzu to distant-line status, in accord with the principle that the son bends for the father.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Heng proposed honoring Xizu as founding ancestor and next moving Shunzu to distant-line status, in accord with the principle that the son bends for the father.

sentences.zh: 推僖祖侑感生之祀，而罷宣祖配位，以合祖以孫尊之義，餘且如舊制。」

translations.literal: Advance Xizu to assist at the Life-Giving Emperor sacrifice and discontinue Xuanzu's pairing position, in accord with honoring the ancestor through the grandson; the rest should follow former regulations."
translations.idiomatic: Advance Xizu to assist at the Life-Giving Emperor sacrifice and discontinue Xuanzu's pairing, honoring the ancestor through the grandson; the rest should follow former regulations.

sentences.zh: 而馮京欲以太祖正東向之位，安石力主元絳初議，遂從 之。

translations.literal: Feng Jing wished Taizu to occupy the correct east-facing position, but Wang Anshi strongly upheld Yuan Jiang's initial deliberation, and this was adopted.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Jing wished Taizu to occupy the correct east-facing position, but Wang Anshi strongly upheld Yuan Jiang's initial proposal, and this was adopted.

sentences.zh: 帝問：「配天孰始？」

translations.literal: The emperor asked: "Who first paired with Heaven?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor asked who first paired with Heaven.

sentences.zh: 安石曰：「宣祖見配感生帝，欲改以僖祖配。」

translations.literal: Wang Anshi said: "Xuanzu is presently paired with the Life-Giving Emperor; we wish to change this so Xizu is paired."
translations.idiomatic: Wang Anshi replied that Xuanzu was presently paired with the Life-Giving Emperor and they wished to change this so Xizu was paired.

sentences.zh: 帝然之。

translations.literal: The emperor approved.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 於是請奉僖祖神主為始祖，遷順祖神主夾室，以僖祖配感生帝祀。

translations.literal: Thereupon they requested installing Xizu's spirit tablet as founding ancestor, moving Shunzu's tablet to a flanking chamber, and pairing Xizu with the Life-Giving Emperor at sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: They then requested installing Xizu's tablet as founding ancestor, moving Shunzu's tablet to a flanking chamber, and pairing Xizu with the Life-Giving Emperor at sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 詔下太常禮院 詳定儀注。

translations.literal: An edict was issued to the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to fix the ritual regulations in detail.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to fix the ritual regulations in detail.

sentences.zh: 安石本議以僖祖配天，帝不許，故更以配感生帝焉。

translations.literal: Wang Anshi had originally proposed pairing Xizu with Heaven; the emperor did not permit this, so instead he was paired with the Life-Giving Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Anshi had originally proposed pairing Xizu with Heaven; the emperor did not permit this, so Xizu was paired with the Life-Giving Emperor instead.

sentences.zh: 元豐元年，詳定郊廟禮文所圖上八廟異宮之制，以始祖居中，分昭穆為左右。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yuanfeng, the office for fixing border and temple ritual submitted a diagram of eight temples in separate palaces, with the founding ancestor centered and zhao and mu divided left and right.
translations.idiomatic: In 1078, the office for fixing border and temple ritual submitted a plan for eight temples in separate palaces, with the founding ancestor centered and zhao and mu divided left and right.

sentences.zh: 自北而 南，僖祖為始祖；

translations.literal: From north to south, Xizu as founding ancestor;
translations.idiomatic: From north to south, Xizu as founding ancestor;

sentences.zh: 翼祖、太祖、太宗、仁宗為穆，在右；

translations.literal: Yizu, Taizu, Taizong, and Renzong as mu, on the right;
translations.idiomatic: Yizu, Taizu, Taizong, and Renzong as mu, on the right;

sentences.zh: 宣祖、真宗、英宗為昭，在左。

translations.literal: Xuanzu, Zhenzong, and Yingzong as zhao, on the left.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzu, Zhenzong, and Yingzong as zhao, on the left.

sentences.zh: 皆南面北上。

translations.literal: All faced south, ascending toward the north.
translations.idiomatic: All faced south, ascending toward the north.

sentences.zh: 陸佃言：「太祖之廟百世不遷，三昭三穆，親盡則迭毀。

translations.literal: Lu Dian stated: "Taizu's temple is never moved for a hundred generations; three zhao and three mu are successively destroyed when affection is exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Dian stated that Taizu's temple is never moved for a hundred generations, while three zhao and three mu are successively destroyed when affection is exhausted.

sentences.zh: 如周 以後稷為太祖，王季為昭，文王為穆，武王為昭，成王為穆，康王為昭，昭王為穆，其後穆王入廟，王季親盡而遷，則文王宜居昭位，武王宜居穆位，成王、昭王宜 居昭位，康王、穆王宜居穆位，所謂父昭子穆是也。

translations.literal: As Zhou took Hou Ji as Grand Ancestor: King Ji as zhao, King Wen as mu, King Wu as zhao, King Cheng as mu, King Kang as zhao, King Zhao as mu—afterward when King Mu entered the temple and King Ji's affection was exhausted and he was moved, King Wen should occupy zhao, King Wu mu, King Cheng and King Zhao zhao, King Kang and King Mu mu—this is what is called father zhao, son mu.
translations.idiomatic: As Zhou took Hou Ji as Grand Ancestor: King Ji as zhao, King Wen as mu, King Wu as zhao, King Cheng as mu, King Kang as zhao, King Zhao as mu—when King Mu entered and King Ji was moved, King Wen should occupy zhao, King Wu mu, King Cheng and King Zhao zhao, King Kang and King Mu mu—father zhao, son mu.

sentences.zh: 說者以昭常為昭，穆常為穆，則尊卑失序。」

translations.literal: Those who explain hold that if zhao is always zhao and mu always mu, then senior and junior lose order."
translations.idiomatic: Those who explain that zhao is always zhao and mu always mu would make senior and junior lose order.

sentences.zh: 復圖上八廟昭穆之制，以翼祖、太祖、太宗、仁宗為昭，在左；

translations.literal: They resubmitted a diagram of the eight-temple zhao-mu system: Yizu, Taizu, Taizong, and Renzong as zhao, on the left;
translations.idiomatic: They resubmitted a diagram of the eight-temple zhao-mu system: Yizu, Taizu, Taizong, and Renzong as zhao, on the left;

sentences.zh: 宣 祖、真宗、英宗為穆，在右。

translations.literal: Xuanzu, Zhenzong, and Yingzong as mu, on the right.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzu, Zhenzong, and Yingzong as mu, on the right.

sentences.zh: 皆南面北上。

translations.literal: All faced south, ascending toward the north.
translations.idiomatic: All faced south, ascending toward the north.

sentences.zh: 何洵直圖上八廟異宮，引熙寧儀：僖祖正東向之位，順祖、宣祖、真宗、英宗南面為昭，翼祖、太祖、太 宗、仁宗北面為穆，正得祖宗繼序、德厚流光之本意。

translations.literal: He Xunzhi submitted a diagram of eight temples in separate palaces, citing Xining ritual regulations: Xizu in the correct east-facing position; Shunzu, Xuanzu, Zhenzong, and Yingzong facing south as zhao; Yizu, Taizu, Taizong, and Renzong facing north as mu—truly capturing the original intent of ancestral succession and virtue deep with radiance far-reaching.
translations.idiomatic: He Xunzhi submitted a plan for eight temples in separate palaces, citing Xining regulations: Xizu east-facing; Shunzu, Xuanzu, Zhenzong, and Yingzong south as zhao; Yizu, Taizu, Taizong, and Renzong north as mu—capturing the intent of orderly succession and enduring virtue.

sentences.zh: 又以晉孫毓、唐賈公彥言「始祖居中，三昭在左，南面西上；

translations.literal: He also cited Jin's Sun Yu and Tang's Jia Gongyan: 'The founding ancestor is centered; three zhao are on the left, facing south ascending west;
translations.idiomatic: He also cited Jin's Sun Yu and Tang's Jia Gongyan: the founding ancestor is centered; three zhao are on the left, facing south ascending west;

sentences.zh: 三穆在右，南面東上。」

translations.literal: three mu are on the right, facing south ascending east.'
translations.idiomatic: three mu are on the right, facing south ascending east.

sentences.zh: 為兩圖上之。

translations.literal: He submitted both diagrams.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted both diagrams.

sentences.zh: 又援《祭 法》，言：「翼祖、宣祖在二祧之位，猶同祖禰之廟，皆月祭之，與親廟一等，無親疏遠近之殺。

translations.literal: He also cited the Record of Sacrifices, stating: "Yizu and Xuanzu occupy the two distant-line positions, yet like the temples of grandfather and father they receive monthly sacrifice, equal to direct-line temples, without gradation of close and distant.
translations.idiomatic: He also cited the Record of Sacrifices: Yizu and Xuanzu occupy the two distant-line positions yet, like grandfather and father, receive monthly sacrifice equal to direct-line temples, without gradation of close and distant.

sentences.zh: 順祖實去祧之主，若有四時祈禱，猶當就壇受祭。

translations.literal: Shunzu is in fact a lord removed to distant-line status; if there are seasonal prayers, he should still receive sacrifice at the altar.
translations.idiomatic: Shunzu is in fact a lord moved to distant-line status; for seasonal prayers he should still receive sacrifice at the altar.

sentences.zh: 請自今二祧神 主，殺於親廟，四時之祭，享嘗乃止，不及大烝，不薦新物。

translations.literal: We request that henceforth the two distant-line spirit tablets be reduced below direct-line temples: seasonal sacrifices stop at offering and tasting, not reaching the great xia, and no new produce is presented.
translations.idiomatic: We propose that henceforth the two distant-line tablets be reduced below direct-line temples: seasonal sacrifices stop at offering and tasting, not reaching the great xia, with no new produce presented.

sentences.zh: 去祧神主，有禱則為壇而祭，庶合典禮。」

translations.literal: For lords removed to distant-line status, when there is prayer an altar is made for sacrifice—this may accord with canonical ritual."
translations.idiomatic: For lords moved to distant-line status, when prayer is needed an altar should be made for sacrifice—in accord with canonical ritual.

sentences.zh: 又請建新廟於始祖之西，略如古方明壇製。

translations.literal: He also requested building a new temple west of the founding ancestor, roughly following the ancient square-bright altar design.
translations.idiomatic: He also proposed building a new temple west of the founding ancestor, roughly following the ancient square-bright altar design.

sentences.zh: 有詔，俟廟製成 日取旨。

translations.literal: An edict was issued to await the day the temple system was completed before taking imperial decision.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered awaiting completion of the temple system before taking imperial decision.

sentences.zh: 三年，禮文所言：「古者宗廟為石室以藏主，謂之宗祏。

translations.literal: In the third year, the ritual regulations stated: "In antiquity ancestral temples used stone chambers to store tablets, called the ancestral tablet repository.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, the ritual regulations stated that in antiquity ancestral temples used stone chambers to store tablets, called the ancestral tablet repository.

sentences.zh: 夫婦一體，同幾共牢。

translations.literal: Husband and wife are one body, sharing the same offering table and sacrificial pen.
translations.idiomatic: Husband and wife are one body, sharing the same offering table and sacrificial pen.

sentences.zh: 一室之中，有左主、右主之別，正廟之主，各藏廟室西壁之 中；

translations.literal: Within one chamber there is distinction of left tablet and right tablet; tablets of the main temple are each stored in the center of the west wall of the temple chamber;
translations.idiomatic: Within one chamber there is distinction of left tablet and right tablet; main-temple tablets are each stored in the center of the chamber's west wall;

sentences.zh: 遷廟之主，藏於太祖太室北壁之中，其埳去地六尺一寸。

translations.literal: tablets of moved temples are stored in the center of the north wall of the Grand Ancestor's great chamber; the niche is six feet one inch from the ground.
translations.idiomatic: moved tablets are stored in the center of the north wall of the Grand Ancestor's great chamber, the niche six feet one inch from the ground.

sentences.zh: 今太廟藏主之室，帝後異處，遷主仍藏西夾室，求之於禮，有所未合。

translations.literal: Today the ancestral temple's tablet-storage chambers separate emperor and empress; moved tablets are still stored in the west flanking chamber—seeking this in ritual, something does not accord.
translations.idiomatic: Today the ancestral temple separates emperor and empress in storage, and moved tablets remain in the west flanking chamber—something does not accord with ritual.

sentences.zh: 請新廟成，並遵古制。」

translations.literal: We request that when the new temple is completed, all follow the ancient system."
translations.idiomatic: We request that when the new temple is completed, all follow the ancient system.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: This was approved.

sentences.zh: 二月，慈聖光獻皇后祔廟，前二日，告天地、社稷、太廟、皇后廟如故事。

translations.literal: In the second month, Empress Cisheng Guangxian was enshrined in the temple; two days before, Heaven and Earth, the altars of soil and grain, the Imperial Ancestral Temple, and the empress temple were notified according to precedent.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Empress Cisheng Guangxian was enshrined in the temple; two days before, Heaven and Earth, the altars of soil and grain, the ancestral temple, and the empress temple were notified according to precedent.

sentences.zh: 至日，奉神主先詣僖祖室，次翼祖室，次宣祖室，次太祖室，次太宗室。

translations.literal: On the day, the spirit tablets were first brought to the Xizu chamber, then Yizu, Xuanzu, Taizu, and Taizong chambers.
translations.idiomatic: On the day, the spirit tablets were first brought to the Xizu chamber, then Yizu, Xuanzu, Taizu, and Taizong chambers.

sentences.zh: 次太宗與懿德皇 後、明德皇后同一祝，次享元德皇后。

translations.literal: Next Taizong shared one prayer text with Empresses Yide and Mingde; next the Primordial Virtue Empress was honored.
translations.idiomatic: Next Taizong shared one prayer with Empresses Yide and Mingde; next the Primordial Virtue Empress was honored.

sentences.zh: 慈聖光獻皇后，異饌位、異祝，行祔謁禮。
