translations.literal: Empress Cisheng Guangxian had a separate offering station and separate prayer, performing the enshrinement visitation rite.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Cisheng Guangxian had a separate offering station and prayer, performing the enshrinement visitation rite.

sentences.zh: 次真宗室，次仁宗室，次英宗室。

translations.literal: Next the Zhenzong chamber, then Renzong, then Yingzong.
translations.idiomatic: Next the Zhenzong chamber, then Renzong, then Yingzong.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，奉神主歸仁宗室。

translations.literal: When the rites were complete, the spirit tablets were returned to the Renzong chamber.
translations.idiomatic: When the rites were complete, the spirit tablets were returned to the Renzong chamber.

sentences.zh: 元豐六年 六月，孝惠、孝章、淑德、章懷四後升祔，準章獻明肅、章懿二後，升祔禮畢，遞享太廟，止行升祔享禮及祭七祀，權罷孟冬薦享，仍以配繼先後為序。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the sixth year of Yuanfeng, Empresses Xiaohui, Xiaozhang, Shude, and Zhanghuai were elevated and enshrined; following Empresses Zhangxian Mingsu and Zhangyi, after the elevation-enshrinement rites were complete they proceeded through the Imperial Ancestral Temple, performing only the elevation-enshrinement honoring rite and sacrifice to the seven household spirits, provisionally suspending the mid-winter offering, still ordering by sequence of consort succession.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of 1083, Empresses Xiaohui, Xiaozhang, Shude, and Zhanghuai were elevated and enshrined; following Empresses Zhangxian Mingsu and Zhangyi, after the rites they proceeded through the ancestral temple, performing only the elevation-enshrinement honoring rite and sacrifice to the seven household spirits, provisionally suspending the mid-winter offering, ordered by consort succession.

sentences.zh: 八年，禮部 太常寺言：「詔書定七世八室之制。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, the Ministry of Rites and Court of Imperial Sacrifices stated: "The edict fixed the system of seven generations and eight chambers.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, the Ministry of Rites and Court of Imperial Sacrifices reported that the edict had fixed the system of seven generations and eight chambers.

sentences.zh: 今神宗皇帝崇祔，翼祖在七世之外，與簡穆皇后祧藏於西夾室，置石室中。」

translations.literal: Now that Emperor Shenzong is solemnly enshrined, Yizu lies beyond the seven generations and is stored in distant-line fashion with Empress Jianmu in the west flanking chamber, placed in a stone chamber."
translations.idiomatic: With Emperor Shenzong solemnly enshrined, Yizu lies beyond the seven generations and is stored in distant-line fashion with Empress Jianmu in the west flanking chamber's stone chamber.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁酉，祔神宗神主於第八室。

translations.literal: On dingyou in the eleventh month, Shenzong's spirit tablet was installed in the eighth chamber.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day of the eleventh month, Shenzong's spirit tablet was installed in the eighth chamber.

sentences.zh: 自英宗上至宣 祖以次升遷。

translations.literal: From Yingzong upward to Xuanzu, each was moved in succession.
translations.idiomatic: From Yingzong upward to Xuanzu, each shrine was shifted in succession.

sentences.zh: 紹聖元年二月，祔宣仁聖烈皇后於太廟。

translations.literal: In the second month of the first year of Shaosheng, Empress Xuanren Shengle was enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of 1094, Empress Xuanren Shengle was enshrined in the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 元符三年，禮部太常寺言：「哲宗升祔，宜如晉成帝故事，於太廟殿增一室，候祔廟日，神主祔 第九室。」

translations.literal: In the third year of Yuanfu, the Ministry of Rites and Court of Imperial Sacrifices stated: "When Zhezong is elevated and enshrined, it should follow Emperor Cheng of Jin's precedent—add one chamber to the ancestral temple hall, and when the enshrinement day arrives, install the spirit tablet in the ninth chamber."
translations.idiomatic: In 1100, the Ministry of Rites and Court of Imperial Sacrifices proposed that Zhezong's elevation and enshrinement follow Emperor Cheng of Jin's precedent—add one chamber to the temple hall and install the tablet in the ninth chamber on the enshrinement day.

sentences.zh: 詔下侍從官議，皆如所言。

translations.literal: An edict was issued for attendant officials to deliberate; all agreed with the proposal.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered attendant officials to deliberate; all agreed.

sentences.zh: 蔡京議：「以哲宗嗣神宗大統，父子相承，自當為世。

translations.literal: Cai Jing deliberated: "Zhezong succeeded Shenzong's great succession; father and son continued in line—they naturally constitute one generation.
translations.idiomatic: Cai Jing argued that Zhezong succeeded Shenzong's great succession; father and son continued in line—they naturally constitute one generation.

sentences.zh: 今若不祧遠祖，不以哲宗為世，則三昭四穆與太祖之廟而八。

translations.literal: If we do not now move the remote ancestor to distant-line status and do not count Zhezong as a generation, there will be three zhao, four mu, and the Grand Ancestor's temple—eight in all.
translations.idiomatic: If we do not move the remote ancestor to distant-line status and do not count Zhezong as a generation, there will be three zhao, four mu, and the Grand Ancestor's temple—eight in all.

sentences.zh: 宜深考載 籍，遷祔如禮。」

translations.literal: We should deeply examine the records and move and enshrine according to ritual."
translations.idiomatic: We should deeply examine the records and move and enshrine according to ritual.

sentences.zh: 陸佃、曾肇等議：「國朝自僖祖而下始備七廟，故英宗祔廟，則遷順祖，神宗祔廟，則遷翼祖。

translations.literal: Lu Dian, Zeng Zhao, and others deliberated: "Our dynasty from Xizu downward first completed seven temples; hence when Yingzong was enshrined, Shunzu was moved; when Shenzong was enshrined, Yizu was moved.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Dian, Zeng Zhao, and others argued that our dynasty from Xizu downward first completed seven temples; when Yingzong was enshrined, Shunzu was moved; when Shenzong was enshrined, Yizu was moved.

sentences.zh: 今哲宗於神宗，父子也，如禮官議，則廟中當有八 世。

translations.literal: Now Zhezong and Shenzong are father and son; if we follow the ritual officials' proposal, the temple should have eight generations.
translations.idiomatic: Zhezong and Shenzong are father and son; if we follow the ritual officials' proposal, the temple should have eight generations.

sentences.zh: 況唐文宗即位則遷肅宗，以敬宗為一世，故事不遠。

translations.literal: Moreover, when Tang's Wenzong took the throne, Suzong was moved and Emperor Jing counted as one generation—the precedent is not remote.
translations.idiomatic: When Tang's Wenzong took the throne, Suzong was moved and Emperor Jing counted as one generation—the precedent is not remote.

sentences.zh: 哲宗祔廟，當以神宗為昭，上遷宣祖，以合古三昭三穆之義。」

translations.literal: When Zhezong is enshrined, Shenzong should be zhao and Xuanzu moved upward—in accord with the ancient meaning of three zhao and three mu."
translations.idiomatic: When Zhezong is enshrined, Shenzong should be zhao and Xuanzu moved upward—in accord with three zhao and three mu.

sentences.zh: 先是，李清臣為禮部尚書，首建增室之議， 侍郎趙挺之等和之。

translations.literal: Earlier, Li Qingchen as Minister of Rites first proposed adding a chamber; Vice Minister Zhao Tingzhi and others concurred.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Li Qingchen as Minister of Rites first proposed adding a chamber; Vice Minister Zhao Tingzhi and others concurred.

sentences.zh: 會清臣為門下侍郎，論者多從其議，惟京、佃等議異。

translations.literal: When Qingchen became Vice Director of the Secretariat, most debaters followed his proposal; only Cai Jing, Lu Dian, and others differed.
translations.idiomatic: When Qingchen became Vice Director of the Secretariat, most debaters followed his proposal; only Cai Jing, Lu Dian, and others differed.

sentences.zh: 二議既上，清臣辯說甚力，帝迄從焉。

translations.literal: When both proposals were submitted, Qingchen argued vigorously, and the emperor ultimately followed him.
translations.idiomatic: When both proposals were submitted, Qingchen argued vigorously, and the emperor ultimately followed him.

sentences.zh: 六月，禮部請用太廟東夾室奉安哲宗 神主。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, the Ministry of Rites requested using the east flanking chamber of the Imperial Ancestral Temple to install Zhezong's spirit tablet.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, the Ministry of Rites proposed using the ancestral temple's east flanking chamber to install Zhezong's spirit tablet.

sentences.zh: 太常少卿孫傑言：「先帝神主，錯之夾室，即是不得祔於正廟，與前詔增建一室之議不同。

translations.literal: Vice Director of Imperial Sacrifices Sun Jie stated: "The late emperor's spirit tablet, placed in a flanking chamber, means he cannot be enshrined in the main temple—this differs from the earlier edict's proposal to add a chamber.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Director Sun Jie of Imperial Sacrifices argued that placing the late emperor's tablet in a flanking chamber means he cannot be enshrined in the main temple—contrary to the earlier edict to add a chamber.

sentences.zh: 昨用嘉祐故事，專置使修奉，請以夾室奉安神主，亦與元置使之意 相違。

translations.literal: We used the Jiayou precedent and specially appointed a commissioner for maintenance; to request installing the spirit tablet in a flanking chamber also contradicts the original intent of appointing a commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: We used the Jiayou precedent and appointed a maintenance commissioner; installing the tablet in a flanking chamber also contradicts the original intent.

sentences.zh: 請如太常前議，增建一室。」

translations.literal: We request following the Court of Imperial Sacrifices' earlier proposal to add a chamber."
translations.idiomatic: We request following the Court of Imperial Sacrifices' earlier proposal to add a chamber.

sentences.zh: 尚書省以廟室未備，行禮有期，權宜升祔，隨即增修，比之前代設幄行事者，不為不至。

translations.literal: The Department of State Affairs held that temple chambers were not ready and the rite had a fixed date; provisionally enshrining for the moment and repairing immediately afterward was not less thorough than former ages' practice of erecting tents to perform the rites.
translations.idiomatic: The Department of State Affairs held that chambers were not ready and the rite had a fixed date; provisional enshrinement with immediate repair was not less thorough than former ages' practice of erecting tents for the rites.

sentences.zh: 詔依初旨行之，乃祔哲宗神主於夾室。

translations.literal: An edict ordered following the original intent; Zhezong's spirit tablet was enshrined in a flanking chamber.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered following the original intent; Zhezong's spirit tablet was enshrined in a flanking chamber.

sentences.zh: 崇寧二年，祧宣祖與昭憲皇后神主藏西夾室，居翼祖、簡穆皇后石室之次。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chongning, Xuanzu and Empress Zhaoxian's spirit tablets were moved to distant-line status and stored in the west flanking chamber, next to the stone chamber of Yizu and Empress Jianmu.
translations.idiomatic: In 1103, Xuanzu and Empress Zhaoxian's tablets were moved to distant-line status and stored in the west flanking chamber, next to Yizu and Empress Jianmu's stone chamber.

sentences.zh: 五年，詔曰：「去古既遠，諸儒之說不同。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, an edict stated: "We are far from antiquity, and the various Confucians' theories differ.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, an edict stated that we are far from antiquity and the various Confucians' theories differ.

sentences.zh: 鄭氏謂：『太祖及文、武不祧之廟與親廟 四，為七。』

translations.literal: Master Zheng said: 'The Grand Ancestor and the temples of Wen and Wu that are never moved to distant-line status, together with four direct-line temples, make seven.'
translations.idiomatic: Master Zheng held that the Grand Ancestor and the temples of Wen and Wu never moved to distant-line status, together with four direct-line temples, make seven.

sentences.zh: 是不祧之宗，在七廟之內。

translations.literal: The ancestors never moved to distant-line status are within the seven temples.
translations.idiomatic: The ancestors never moved to distant-line status are within the seven temples.

sentences.zh: 王氏謂：『非太祖而不毀，不為常數。』

translations.literal: Master Wang said: 'Those not the Grand Ancestor yet not destroyed are not a constant rule.'
translations.idiomatic: Master Wang held that those not the Grand Ancestor yet not destroyed are not a constant rule.

sentences.zh: 是不祧之宗，在七廟之外。

translations.literal: The ancestors never moved to distant-line status are outside the seven temples.
translations.idiomatic: The ancestors never moved to distant-line status are outside the seven temples.

sentences.zh: 本朝今已五宗，則七廟當祧者，二宗而已。

translations.literal: Our dynasty now has five zong; of the seven temples, only two should be moved to distant-line status.
translations.idiomatic: Our dynasty now has five zong; of the seven temples, only two should be moved to distant-line status.

sentences.zh: 遷毀之禮， 近及祖考，殆非先王尊祖之意，宜令有司復議。」

translations.literal: The rite of moving and destroying now reaches nearly to grandfather and father—this scarcely accords with the former kings' intent to honor ancestors. The responsible officials should deliberate again."
translations.idiomatic: The rite of moving and destroying now reaches nearly to grandfather and father—scarcely accord with the former kings' intent to honor ancestors. The responsible officials should deliberate again.

sentences.zh: 禮官言：「先王之制，廟止於七，後王以義起禮，乃有增置九廟者。」

translations.literal: The ritual officials stated: "The former kings' system fixed temples at seven; later kings, establishing ritual by principle, added nine temples."
translations.idiomatic: The ritual officials stated that the former kings fixed temples at seven; later kings, establishing ritual by principle, added nine temples.

sentences.zh: 禮部尚書徐鐸又言：「唐之獻祖、中宗、代 宗與本朝僖祖，皆嘗祧而復。

translations.literal: Minister of Rites Xu Duo also stated: "Tang's Xianzu, Zhongzong, and Daizong and our dynasty's Xizu were all once moved to distant-line status and restored.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Rites Xu Duo also noted that Tang's Xianzu, Zhongzong, and Daizong and our dynasty's Xizu were all once moved to distant-line status and restored.

sentences.zh: 今存宣祖於當祧之際，復翼祖於已祧之後，以備九廟，禮無不稱。」

translations.literal: Now to retain Xuanzu at the moment he should be moved to distant-line status and restore Yizu after he was already moved, to complete nine temples—ritual has nothing improper."
translations.idiomatic: To retain Xuanzu when he should be moved to distant-line status and restore Yizu after he was already moved, to complete nine temples—nothing improper in ritual.

sentences.zh: 乃命鐸為修奉使，增太廟殿為十室。

translations.literal: Xu Duo was appointed maintenance commissioner, and the ancestral temple hall was expanded to ten chambers.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Duo was appointed maintenance commissioner, and the ancestral temple hall was expanded to ten chambers.

sentences.zh: 四年十二月，復翼祖、宣祖 廟，行奉安禮，惟不用前期誓戒及亞、終獻之樂舞焉。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the fourth year, the temples of Yizu and Xuanzu were restored and the installation rite performed, only without the prior oath of abstinence and the music and dance of the secondary and final offerings.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the fourth year, the temples of Yizu and Xuanzu were restored and the installation rite performed, only without the prior oath of abstinence and the secondary and final offerings' music and dance.

sentences.zh: 高宗建炎二年，奉太廟神主於揚州壽寧寺。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jianyan under Gaozong, the Imperial Ancestral Temple spirit tablets were brought to Shouning Temple in Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In 1128, under Gaozong, the ancestral temple spirit tablets were brought to Shouning Temple in Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 三年，幸杭州，奉安於溫州。

translations.literal: In the third year, the emperor visited Hangzhou and the tablets were installed in Wenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the following year, the emperor visited Hangzhou and the tablets were installed in Wenzhou.

sentences.zh: 紹興五年，司封郎中林待聘言：「太廟神主宜在國都。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Shaoxing, Lin Daiping, Director of the Bureau of Enfeoffment, stated: "The Imperial Ancestral Temple spirit tablets should be in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In 1135, Lin Daiping, Director of the Bureau of Enfeoffment, argued that the ancestral temple spirit tablets should be in the capital.

sentences.zh: 今新邑未奠，當如古行師載主之義，遷之行闕，以彰聖孝。」

translations.literal: The new capital is not yet settled; we should follow antiquity's principle of carrying tablets when the army marches, moving them to the traveling palace to display imperial filial piety."
translations.idiomatic: The new capital is not yet settled; we should follow antiquity's principle of carrying tablets when the army marches, moving them to the traveling palace to display imperial filial piety.

sentences.zh: 於是始建太廟於臨安，奉迎安置。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Imperial Ancestral Temple was first built at Lin'an, and the tablets were welcomed and installed.
translations.idiomatic: The ancestral temple was first built at Lin'an, and the tablets were welcomed and installed.
